Archive works both ways. Open the two versions below. In **each**, do this:

1. On any bookmark, open **More ▾** and choose **Archive**. It disappears from your collection, and (confirm this) it no longer shows up under All / To read / Finished or in search — it's tucked away without being deleted.
2. Now open the **Archived** view and **Restore** that bookmark — it returns to your collection.

The two differ only in *how you get to the Archived view*:

- **Option A — a separate "Archived" link:** http://maker:4001/arch-a.html
  A **🗄 Archived (n)** link sits at the right of the controls; click it to see archived items, and **← Back to collection** to return.

- **Option B — an Active / Archived switch:** http://maker:4001/arch-b.html
  A distinct **Active | Archived** switch (kept separate from the To read / Finished switch) toggles between your live collection and the archive.

Assumptions to confirm: archiving is **completely separate** from whether you've finished reading something; archived items are **hidden from the normal collection and search**; and the Archived view is a holding area where you can **Restore** (or still permanently Delete).
